notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill covers auditing hosts against CIS benchmarks with OpenSCAP, Lynis, a two-control InSpec profile and kube-bench, plus a scan/analyze/remediate/validate workflow and best practices.

Medium: following it has the agent apt-install openscap-scanner, scap-security-guide and lynis, run audits that write report files (results.xml, report.html, /tmp/lynis-report.dat), run InSpec over SSH against a target host, and run the kube-bench container (unpinned :latest) with /etc and /var mounted read-only. Acceptable because the commands are read-only assessments of the user's own systems; remediation is described only as a generic workflow step with no automated changes.

Users should know: the skill does not reproduce CIS benchmark text; it relies on the CIS profile shipped with scap-security-guide and on kube-bench's checks. Related Skills (SKILL.md:125-126) link to sibling skills ../linux-hardening/ and ../../scanning/vulnerability-scanning/ as optional reading only.
